question: The amount of a certain sum at simple interest at 15% p.a. in 5(1)/({2)} years, is Rs. 1,755 more than the simple interest on the same sum at the same rate in 10 years. What is the sum (in Rs.)?
solution:
**Given:**

Rate = 15%

Time = 5 {(1)/(2)} years

Differences of amount and simple interest are Rs.1755 at the same rate in 10 years

**Formula used:**

SI = PTR/100

A = P + SI

where, Amount = A, Princple = P, Time = T & Rate = R

**Calculation:**

Let the sum be x

SI = (x × 11/2&
